title: refactor(ci): consolidate lint/test/release workflows + bump actions, upgrade node to 20
author: Ava Chen
description:
Motivation: consolidate multiple repo-level GitHub Actions workflows (lint, test, release automation) into a smaller set of reusable workflows to reduce duplication, speed up iteration, and centralize action version management. This PR upgrades Node toolchain on runner jobs to node 20, bumps key GitHub Actions and action versions (checkout, setup-node, actions/cache), and replaces duplicated workflow fragments with a single reusable workflow where appropriate.

What changed (high level):
- Introduced .github/workflows/ci-composite.yml (reusable jobs for lint/test/build matrix) and .github/workflows/release.yml (simplified release automation using up-to-date actions).
- Removed several per-repo workflow copies and replaced them with calls to reusable workflows.
- Updated node-version to 20 in all job matrices; updated setup-node action to v4; bumped actions/checkout to v4 and actions/cache to v4.
- Consolidated lint and test steps into a shared job template and added a small script to standardize environment setup (scripts/ci/setup_node.sh).
- Cleaned up legacy workflow triggers (removed schedule-based nightly lint runs in favor of event-based runs to reduce unnecessary runs).
- Small ancillary updates to package.json devDependencies (eslint, typescript) where tests required lint rule fixes.

Testing and rollout:
- CI: ran in a sibling branch across core repos; test matrix includes node 18/20 temporarily during rollout window (now narrowed to 20 after validation).
- Manual smoke: ran full test+lint suite on redwood monorepo and on redwood-sdk-python & redwood-sdk-typescript integrations.
- Rollout plan: merge to main, monitor Actions usage and queue durations for 72 hours, revert path documented.

Checklist:
- [x] Replaced duplicated workflows with reusable workflow calls
- [x] Upgraded setup-node and checkout actions
- [x] Validated lint/test matrix on representative modules
- [x] Added short migration note to infra/README.md

Notes: Keeping release automation triggers intentionally conservative (manual/dispatch + tags) until next release window. No behavioral changes to release artifacts expected.
